fusions.name: Scalding Steam
fusions.desc: Breathes steam in a 4-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 26 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Burning] for 5 seconds. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Boiling Bead
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of boiling water that deals 7 damage and scalds the target, leaving it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Veil of Vapour
fusions.desc: Turns the water on your feathers to steam: your fire damage rises by 25% for 12 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Pressure Vent
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack of steam builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all vent at once on the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (122% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. You take 10% less fire damage.
